title: ConnectionHelperRefreshParams
description: Press Refresh on the far helper of one pane's connection (ADR-727g63tr decision 2; design §5.10 lifecycle scenario 4). The press is the pane.connection's own offer, so it names the pane and the epoch that carried it: a press about any other observation is about an axis the person is no longer looking at, and the backend refuses it. The refresh redials the helper already installed and completes a new hello; it never installs and never accepts anything, and any state without the refresh offer — serving, starting, an absent decision, a paused connection — has no button to press.

paneId.description: The pane whose connection's helper is refreshed. It is the renderer's own durable id, the same one pane.connection is keyed by, and it must be a pane this backend instance opened: the offer it presses belongs to that pane's newest observation.

connectionEpoch.description: The epoch from the pane.connection observation whose helper object offered refresh. Monotonic per pane and minted at observation; a press carrying an older one is refused as stale.
